labels.message: Function `install_dir` performs whole-artifact read and write effects inside one loop.
labels.reason: install_dir reads `from = source.join(&name)` and writes `to = destination.join(&name)`, both derived from the loop's directory entry, so it is a per-item copy, not a rewrite of one loop-invariant artifact.

checks.reason: install_dir writes each file to `destination.join(&name)`, a per-item destination that varies with the loop entry, so this is a per-item copy and not a rewrite of one fixed artifact.
